Work through the initial configuration one step at a time. The extension stays disabled until setup is complete.

Step 1

Save the extension configuration

Enter the tenant, client, authority host, Key Vault URL, metadata wrapping settings, and lock timeout. Local cache mode can skip the Key Vault sign-in step later, but the extension still returns to a locked state after idle timeout or browser restart.

Step 2

Sign in to Key Vault

Interactive sign-in is required before the PIN can be protected with Key Vault wrapping.

Checking authentication state...

Step 3

Set the extension PIN

The extension PIN is used to satisfy required user verification honestly. In Key Vault mode, the verifier is wrapped with the configured metadata key.

Checking PIN protection state...

Use at least 6 characters. Longer is stronger.

Step 4

Setup complete

The extension is ready to intercept WebAuthn requests. You can reopen this wizard later from the extension popup if you need to change configuration or PIN state.
